text.en:
Extension of Moratorium. The moratorium on the payment of the
principal value and annual interest of the amortization due and/or payable by ARBs under
EO No. 4 shall be extended for a period of two (2) years.

Implementing Rules and Regulations. Within fifteen (15) days from
the effectivity of this Order, the DAR and LBP shall jointly formulate the rules and
regulations for the implementation of this Order, in accordance with existing general
banking laws, the rules and regulations of the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas, EO No. 228
(s. 1987), RA No. 6657 or the "Comprehensive Agrarian Reform Law of 1988," as
amended, RA No. 11953, and other relevant laws and issuances.

Funding. The funds for the implementation of this Order, including its
monitoring and evaluation, shall be charged against the existing and available
appropriations of the DAR and LBP, subject to relevant budgeting, accounting and
auditing laws, rules and regulations.

Separability. If any part or provision of this Order shall be held
unconstitutional or invalid, the other provisions not affected thereby shall continue to be
in full force and effect.

Repeal. This Order hereby amends or modifies relevant provisions of
EO No. 4. All other issuances, orders, rules and regulations, or parts thereof that are
inconsistent with this Order, are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately upon publication
in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 12th
